Contact Center Platform Engineer 
 
About Brillio 
Brillio is one of the fastest-growing digital technology service providers, helping Fortune 1000 organizations turn disruption into competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption. Our professionals combine deep technology expertise, design thinking, and a strong commitment to client success to deliver transformative outcomes. Brillio is recognized year after year as a Great Place to Work®, giving talented technology professionals the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and solve complex, high-impact business challenges 
Summary
Own and evolve the enterprise contact-center platform spanning Twilio Flex, IVR/orchestration, middleware integrations, cloud services, and agent-facing UI. This role bridges telephony, APIs, identity, AI capabilities, and reporting so member, provider, and billing journeys work end-to-end.
What you’ll do
Maintain and extend existing Workato and MuleSoft APIs/middleware for member, provider, billing, and related domains
Design and implement event-friendly integration patterns and improve reliability across services
Implement and support SSO (SAML) with Azure AD FS, including session management for web experiences
Build and operate Twilio Flex solutions, including TaskRouter, existing IVR journeys, Twilio Functions, and Conversational Intelligence
Contribute to Studio (or equivalent orchestration) where journey changes require platform support
Evaluate and integrate platform-native / approved enterprise LLM and voice-AI components compatible with Flex; apply speech/DTMF appropriately based on journey risk; apply strong prompt engineering practices
Deliver data and reporting that supports operations, auditability, and journey analytics
Develop and operate AWS services (container and/or serverless per enterprise standards), including Kinesis, Lambda, load balancing, and capacity planning; work with OpenShift where required
Build configuration/admin UIs and agent/member-facing experiences with React, Node.js, TypeScript, Twilio Paste, and CloudFront
What you’ll bring
Strong full-stack skills: React / Node.js / TypeScript, plus solid UI craft (Twilio Paste or similar design systems a plus)
Hands-on experience with Twilio Flex and related contact-center building blocks (TaskRouter, Functions; Studio/IVR familiarity preferred)
Integration experience with enterprise middleware (Workato, MuleSoft, or similar) across business domains
Cloud experience on AWS (Lambda, Kinesis, CloudFront, capacity/load planning) and comfort with container platforms (OpenShift or equivalent)
Working knowledge of SSO/SAML and identity providers (Azure AD FS preferred)
Interest or experience with enterprise LLM / voice-AI patterns, including prompt engineering and speech/DTMF UX constraints
Ability to work across platforms end-to-end—one person owning integration, telephony/orchestration, cloud, UI, and reporting
Nice to have
Prior ownership of production IVR/Studio flows
Conversational Intelligence or similar call analytics tooling
Experience introducing AI into regulated or high-risk customer journeys
How this role is scoped
This is a cross-cutting platform role, not a single-stack specialist job. Success means shipping reliable journeys across middleware, Flex/IVR, identity, cloud, UI, and reporting—with growing ownership of SSO and enterprise AI capabilities.
